goal: Open the contact whose name the user knows (Shamma Waleed Al Romaithi) out of 100,000 contacts and read its mobile number.
done_when: The contact's own record is open on screen and shows the mobile number +971 54 427 3034.

klm.source: Card, Moran & Newell (1980), The keystroke-level model for user performance time with interactive systems, CACM 23(7): K 0.28 s (average non-secretary typist), P 1.10 s, B 0.10 s per press or release, H 0.40 s, M 1.35 s. System response time is measured, not modelled.

path_notes: palette: Ctrl+K > type the contact's name > Enter opens the contact's form. | palette-shortest: Ctrl+K > the shortest word prefixes of the name (three letters or more each) that rank the contact first, e.g. "sha wal rom" > Enter opens the contact's form. | menu: Contacts (navigation; the search box has the focus) > type the name > Enter opens the best match. | goto: G then O (Contacts; the search box has the focus) > type the name > Enter opens the best match. | shortest: Contacts (navigation; the search box has the focus) > the shortest word prefixes of the name (three letters or more each) that rank the contact first, e.g. "sha wal rom" > Enter opens the best match.
task_notes: The name occurs exactly once in the shared dataset (gauntlet/compare/data). Both products hold the same 100,000 contacts.
